decisions.reason: A newly launched handle family that costs little to keep in an architectural catalogue whose sales cycles run for years, so its value is still uncertain and the option is worth holding open.
The mitred handle family is only a year old and specified in long building projects, so its prospects remain unresolved while carrying cost stays low.
A multifunctional handle may serve niche needs whose demand has not yet revealed itself, and keeping it in the range costs little.
A single handle model with no negative signals so far, and dropping it now would give up the option before uncertainty about its value resolves.
Winning the German Design Award and having its own web page are strong early value signals that justify further commitment.
A finish variant applies across existing models at low marginal cost, which makes it a cheap option to keep while demand for patinated bronze becomes clear.
